title: Spiritual Gifts and Ministry of the Holy Spirit
definition: Spiritual gifts and the ministry of the Holy Spirit refer to the Spirit's work of empowering believers for service, building up the church, and glorifying Christ.
summary: The Holy Spirit gives gifts to believers for service, love, and the building up of the church.
christFocus: The Spirit gives gifts that serve Christ's body and draw attention to Christ rather than to human pride or platform.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit ministers to and through believers. He gives spiritual gifts according to God's wisdom so the church may be strengthened, served, and built up in love.

Spiritual gifts are not badges of superiority. They are grace-gifts for service. The Spirit distributes gifts for the common good, and every believer is called to use what God has given with humility and faithfulness.

The ministry of the Spirit always glorifies Christ. Gifts should not become a distraction from the Gospel, a source of pride, or a reason for division. They are given so the body of Christ may mature and serve.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can become confused when gifts are ignored, idolized, compared, or used selfishly. This doctrine matters because it teaches believers that spiritual gifts are for loving service, not personal status.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Identify how God has equipped you and use your gifts to serve others. Refuse comparison and pride. Ask whether your service builds up the body, honors Christ, and expresses love.
